h1. Dynatrace S2 CLOSE Problem SILVA and PagerDuty

{info:title=Audience}
SRE / platform engineers who need to understand the Dynatrace Automations workflow that *resolves* SILVA (ServiceNow) incidents and *resolves* PagerDuty alerts when a Davis problem closes.
{info}

{warning:title=Safety}
This workflow *sends* when active (PATCH SILVA + PagerDuty resolve). Keep it *Draft* or set {{DRY_RUN = true}} until values are confirmed. Never put SILVA passwords or PagerDuty routing keys in Confluence. Pair with the OPEN workflow (S0 preview-then-post): same {{correlation_id}} and {{dedup_key}}. Do not run two different CLOSE workflows for the same problem. Drafts are not triggered.
{warning}

----

h2. Decision tree

{code}
Dynatrace problem CLOSED?
  → prepare-close (problem id, correlation_id, dedup_key, times, cause)
      ├─► close-silva-incident
      │     open SILVA incidents with correlation_id?
      │       NO  → skip (already resolved or OPEN never created)
      │       YES → state / close_code valid?
      │              NO  → fail (lists allowed values)
      │              YES → PATCH each → Resolved (+ notes)
      └─► close-pagerduty (parallel)
            POST Events API event_action=resolve
            same dedup_key OPEN used (dt-problem-<id>)
 Draft status?
  → Drafts are not triggered — Save / Deploy first
{code}

----

h2. Short takeaway

||Question||Answer||
|What is this workflow?|On problem *close*: resolve matching SILVA tickets and resolve the PagerDuty alert|
|UI title (screenshot)|*S2 - CLOSE Problem direct to SILVA and PagerDuty v5*|
|How many tasks?|3 after trigger: prepare-close → close-silva ∥ close-pagerduty|
|Preview gates?|*No* (direct close). OPEN partner S0 still uses preview-then-post|
|Link to OPEN|{{correlation_id}} = problem display id; {{dedup_key}} = {{dt-problem-<id>}}|

----

h2. Summary

When a Davis problem *closes*, this workflow builds the close keys, then in *parallel* finds open SILVA incidents with the same correlation id and PATCHes them to Resolved, and sends a PagerDuty *resolve* with the same dedup key the OPEN flow used. It is the short “direct” CLOSE design (no preview tasks). Use it once {{close_code}} / state values are trusted. Do not also run a second CLOSE graph for the same problems.

----

h2. Words you need first

||Word||What it means||Why you care||
|CLOSED problem|Davis problem recovered / closed|Starts this workflow|
|correlation_id|SILVA field = Dynatrace problem display id (e.g. {{P-261090}})|How CLOSE finds the ticket OPEN created|
|dedup_key|PagerDuty key {{dt-problem-<display_id>}}|Same key OPEN used to trigger; resolve must match|
|PATCH|HTTP update of an existing SILVA incident|Sets state Resolved + close code + notes|
|resolve (PD)|Events API {{event_action: resolve}}|Closes the PD alert for that dedup_key|
|DRY_RUN|Script flag|{{true}} = no real PATCH / POST|
|Direct CLOSE|No preview tasks|Faster; wrong close_code fails the task instead of skipping quietly|

----

h2. How S2 fits with S0 (OPEN)

{code}
S0 OPEN (preview then post)
  problem Active → create SILVA incident (correlation_id = P-…)
                 → PagerDuty trigger (dedup_key = dt-problem-P-…)

S2 CLOSE (this page)
  problem Closed → PATCH SILVA (find by correlation_id)
                 → PagerDuty resolve (same dedup_key)
{code}

||Topic||S0 OPEN||S2 CLOSE||
|Trigger|Problem Active|Problem Closed|
|SILVA|POST new incident|PATCH existing to Resolved|
|PagerDuty|{{event_action: trigger}}|{{event_action: resolve}}|
|Preview tasks|Yes (preview then send)|No (direct)|
|Shared keys|Sets correlation_id + dedup_key|Reuses the same keys|

----

h2. End-to-end picture

{code}
Problem trigger (On: closed problem)
        │
        ▼
prepare-close
  problem_id / display_id
  correlation_id = display_id
  dedup_key = dt-problem-<display_id>
  start / end / duration / cause  (for close notes)
        │
        ├────────────────────────────┐
        ▼                            ▼
close-silva-incident          close-pagerduty
  GET open incidents            POST /v2/enqueue
  GET sys_choice (state,        event_action: resolve
       close_code)              dedup_key: same as OPEN
  PATCH each → Resolved
        │                            │
        ▼                            ▼
   SILVA Resolved               PagerDuty alert resolved
{code}

h2. Task catalog

||#||Task||Runs after||Network?||What it does||
|0|Problem trigger|—|Dynatrace events|Starts when problem is *closed*; categories availability / custom / error / resource / slowdown (as configured)|
|1|prepare-close|trigger|Optional Dynatrace Problems API|Builds ids, times, duration, cause for notes|
|2a|close-silva-incident|prepare-close|SILVA GET + PATCH|Find open incidents by correlation_id; validate choices; PATCH Resolved|
|2b|close-pagerduty|prepare-close|PagerDuty POST|Resolve with same dedup_key (parallel with SILVA)|

----

h2. Step-by-step detail and API calls

h3. 0 — Problem trigger

* *Type:* Dynatrace Workflows davis-problem trigger.
* *Event state:* *closed* (sidebar: Event state = closed).
* *Categories:* availability, custom, error, resource, slowdown (match your OPEN scope where possible).
* *API:* Internal Dynatrace event bus.
* *UI note:* Toggle On does nothing while status is *Draft* (“Drafts are not triggered”).

----

h3. 1 — prepare-close

* *Type:* JavaScript task.
* *Purpose:* One shared prep for both close branches.
* *Optional API:* Dynatrace Problems API v2 (enrich start/end/cause when event alone is thin).
* *Outputs (examples):*

||Field||Example||Used by||
|display_id / problem_id|{{P-261090}}|Both|
|correlation_id|{{P-261090}}|SILVA GET query|
|dedup_key|{{dt-problem-P-261090}}|PagerDuty resolve|
|start / end / duration|timestamps + length|close_notes|
|cause|short root-cause text|close_notes|

* *No SILVA / PagerDuty HTTP here.*

----

h3. 2a — close-silva-incident

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP.
* *Base URL (staging example):* {{https://silvastg.service-now.com}}
* *Gate / skip cases:*
** No open incident for correlation_id → skip (already resolved or OPEN never created)
** Sample/manual guard ({{ALLOW_SAMPLE_POST}}) → skip unless enabled
** {{DRY_RUN}} → build body only, no PATCH

h4. APIs

{code}
1) Find open tickets
GET {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/incident
  ?sysparm_query=correlation_id=<id>^active=true^ORDERBYDESCsys_created_on
  &sysparm_fields=...

2) Validate choice lists (so wrong labels fail loudly)
GET {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/sys_choice
  (state / close_code for incident table)

3) Resolve each open incident (up to a small limit, e.g. 5)
PATCH {SILVA_BASE}/api/now/v2/table/incident/{sys_id}
  ?sysparm_display_value=all&sysparm_exclude_reference_link=true
Body (typical):
  state: <Resolved value>
  close_code: <configured code>
  close_notes: problem id, close time, duration, cause
  work_notes (or comments): DT link, PD key, service context
{code}

* *Auth:* Basic (or Connection secret) — not documented in Confluence.
* *Failure mode:* If {{CLOSE_CODE}} / state label is wrong, task fails and error lists *allowed* values → fix settings and re-run.

----

h3. 2b — close-pagerduty

* *Type:* JavaScript + HTTP.
* *Runs in parallel* with SILVA close (does not wait for PATCH success).
* *Skip cases:* bad/missing dedup_key; sample guard; {{DRY_RUN}}.
* *API:*

{code}
POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {
  "routing_key": "<secret>",
  "event_action": "resolve",
  "dedup_key": "dt-problem-<display_id>"
}
{code}

* *Note:* PagerDuty ignores resolve when no open alert has that dedup_key (safe to always send after a real OPEN). Same key as S0 trigger is mandatory.

----

h2. API call summary

||Task||Direction||Endpoint pattern||Purpose||
|prepare-close|Dynatrace (optional)|Problems API v2|Enrich times / cause|
|close-silva-incident|SILVA GET|{{/api/now/v2/table/incident}}|Find open by correlation_id|
|close-silva-incident|SILVA GET|{{/api/now/v2/table/sys_choice}}|Validate state / close_code|
|close-silva-incident|SILVA PATCH|{{/api/now/v2/table/incident/{sys_id}}}|Set Resolved|
|close-pagerduty|PagerDuty POST|{{https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue}}|{{event_action: resolve}}|

----

h2. Typical SILVA resolve body fields

||Field||What it means||
|state|Resolved (SILVA choice value / label)|
|close_code|e.g. Solved (Permanently) — must match SILVA list|
|close_notes|Problem id, close time, duration, cause|
|work_notes or comments|Dynatrace link, PagerDuty dedup_key, optional service context|

----

h2. Settings operators care about

||Setting||Task||What it means||
|RESOLVED_STATE|close-silva|Target state label/value|
|CLOSE_CODE|close-silva|Resolution code — must exist in SILVA|
|NOTES_FIELD|close-silva|{{work_notes}} (internal) or {{comments}} (caller-visible)|
|EXTRA_FIELDS|close-silva|Extra mandatory fields SILVA needs before Resolved|
|DRY_RUN|both close tasks|{{true}} = no send|
|ALLOW_SAMPLE_POST|both close tasks|Allow manual Run on sample problem id|
|SAMPLE_EVENT.display_id|prepare-close|Problem id for manual test Run|

----

h2. Direct CLOSE vs preview CLOSE

||Topic||S2 direct (this page)||Preview-then-resolve (older design)||
|Tasks|3|More (find → build → preview → send)|
|Wrong close_code|Task fails with allowed values|Preview shows WRONG; send skips|
|Multiple open incidents|Resolves all open (small cap)|Often newest only|
|PagerDuty if SILVA fails|Still resolves|Still resolves|
|Best for|Day-to-day after values confirmed|First tests / auditing|

----

h2. Operator checklist

||Step||Action||
|1|Confirm OPEN (S0) uses same correlation_id and {{dt-problem-}} dedup_key|
|2|Confirm CLOSE_CODE against SILVA sys_choice before go-live|
|3|Allowlist SILVA host + {{events.pagerduty.com}}|
|4|Test with {{DRY_RUN true}} or sample guards first|
|5|Deploy (leave Draft only if you do not want live closes)|
|6|Deactivate any other CLOSE workflow for the same scope|
|7|Close a test problem → SILVA Resolved + PD resolved|

----

h2. Health check

||Check||Pass||
|Trigger|Closed problem starts a run (after Deploy)|
|prepare-close|correlation_id + dedup_key look correct|
|close-silva|{{action: resolved}} or clear skip reason|
|close-pagerduty|HTTP success / {{action: resolved}} or DRY_RUN skip|
|SILVA UI|Incident state Resolved, active false|
|PagerDuty UI|Alert/incident resolved for that dedup_key|
